contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270 - from bust), on a thin bent flan, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust right, probably clean-shaven. Obverse inscription: [----]DIVS AVG. Reverse description: Helmeted soldier standing left with right arm raised, shield at feet, oval object in left field. Reverse inscription: possibly VIR[---]. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 1.07gms, die axis: 12
